name: Magyartelek (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Magyartelek (a green shield with yellow charges, a helm and green and yellow mantling) above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Magyartelek arms with helm, mantling and scroll
